report.lang.label: Language
report.intro: In each small grid, rows are the raiser (the opener) and columns are the position facing the raise. The first row is the theory frequency; the second and third rows show Me and the player pool minus theory (red = more than theory, blue = less than theory).
report.sec.vs4bet.cap: Rows = the opener who 4bets, columns = the 3bettor who has to respond. Hatched = sample <100.
report.sec.vs5bet.cap: R&C has no theory range for this spot, so the rows are Me | Pool | Me − Pool. Rows = the opener who has to respond to the 4bet, columns = the 5bettor. Hatched = sample <20.
report.sec.vs5bet.capTheory: Rows = the opener who has to respond to the 4bet, columns = the 5bettor. Hatched = sample <20.
report.sec.vs5bet.capMixed: Spots with theory use the three rows above; spots without theory are listed below as Me | Pool | Me − Pool. Rows = the opener who has to respond to the 4bet, columns = the 5bettor. Hatched = sample <20.
report.part2.title: Share of all hands: % of every starting hand
report.part2.p1: The frequencies above are conditional: facing a 3bet is measured against your own opening range, facing a 4bet against your own 3bet range. When the earlier range is narrower than theory, the conditional frequency gets inflated. Here every step is multiplied back by the previous one, giving "out of all 1326 starting hands, how many reach this action":
report.part2.li1: Facing a 3bet: open rate × conditional frequency
report.part2.li2: Facing a 4bet: own 3bet rate × conditional frequency
report.part2.li3: Facing a 5bet: open rate × own 4bet rate × conditional frequency
report.part2.cap: The first column, "Reach", is the share of all hands that arrive at this node. The first row is theory %; the second and third rows are ratios (actual ÷ theory, red >1, blue <1, color scale ×0.35 to ×2.8) with the actual % in small print. Facing an open is already over all hands, so no conversion is needed.
report.abs.vs3bet: Share of all hands · Facing a 3bet after opening
report.abs.vs4bet: Share of all hands · Facing a 4bet after 3betting
report.abs.vs4bet.cap: Rows = the opener who 4bets, columns = the 3bettor who has to respond. Reach = the responder's own 3bet rate.
report.abs.vs5bet: Share of all hands · Facing a 5bet after 4betting
report.abs.vs5bet.cap: No theory, so the rows are Me | Pool | Me ÷ Pool. Reach = open rate × own 4bet rate.
report.abs.vs5bet.capMixed: Spots with theory use the three rows above; spots without theory are listed below as Me | Pool | Me ÷ Pool. Reach = open rate × own 4bet rate.
report.footnote: Theory = the theory ranges folder (facing a 3bet is measured against the opening range, facing a 4bet against the 3bet range). Me = the hands of {hero} in the facing seat; Pool = everyone else. Data: {hands} hands, {span}.
report.notice.noRanges: No theory ranges selected: the theory columns show –
report.notice.incomplete: Theory ranges are incomplete: {nodes} nodes missing, {actions} action files missing (counted as 0)
report.dev.title: Deviation summary
report.dev.formula: Spots with n ≥ 30 and |z| ≥ 3, where z = (actual − theory) ÷ √(theory × (1 − theory) ÷ n); the theory value inside the square root is clamped to 0.5%–99.5%. Sorted by effect size h = |2·asin√actual − 2·asin√theory| (Cohen's h; the theory value is not clamped), largest first. Only the action with the largest effect size is listed per spot; click a row to jump to its cell in the report.
report.dev.clampedNote: The theory value is close to 0 or 100%, so the denominator of z uses it clamped to 0.5%–99.5%; the difference and the numerator of z still use the original theory value.
